Each profile has explicit rules: conditions in the same group must all be true (AND), groups are alternatives (OR). When several profiles match, the highest priority wins. Swipe sideways on the clock to pick a profile by hand for an hour. Changes are silent: at most the accent colour changes.

When you connect these headphones, the chosen app (or the last one that played) starts again. Never during a call or if something is already playing.

To pulse on the bass, Onda reads the strength of the sound frequencies coming out of the phone, moment by moment, with Android\'s audio analyser. Android calls this \"microphone\" permission, but nothing is recorded from the microphone, nothing is saved and nothing leaves the phone. It only works while music plays and Onda is on screen. You can turn it off at any time.

Onda looks at when you open your apps and proposes profiles for your routines. Nothing is activated by itself: you decide whether to create, edit or ignore each one.
Remembers only a code of the network name, never the name or your position. Needs the location permission to read the network.

To suggest profiles, Onda reads which apps you open and when, for the last weeks. The data is processed only on your phone and never leaves it. Android will now open its settings: turn on Onda there. You can revoke it at any time.

Rules that run by themselves, only on your phone: a trigger (arriving home, car, night…) and what to do (silent mode, an app or shortcut, a profile, a reminder). Scenes of Google Home or Home Assistant are just shortcuts you add as actions.

They run while Onda is alive in the background (notification access or accessibility help keep it so). Android may block opening apps from the background; system actions and reminders always work.
